description: This file contains functions to create and manipulate JSON objects used in the 'sheens' system, including creating branches, state nodes, reset nodes, time objects, and adding constraints to patterns. It appears to be part of a module related to JSON handling within the 'sheens' interpreter.

methods.name: cJSON * sheens_create_branch(cJSON * pattern,const char * target,bool is_reference)
methods.description: Creates a JSON object representing a branch, with a pattern, target, and reference flag.

methods.name: cJSON * sheens_create_state_node(cJSON * source,cJSON * branch_array,bool is_message)
methods.description: Creates a state node JSON with optional source and branch array, indicating if it is a message.

methods.name: cJSON * sheens_create_reset_node(const char * branch_node)
methods.description: Creates a reset node JSON with a specified branch node string.

methods.name: cJSON * sheens_create_time_object(const icrule_time_t * time)
methods.description: Creates a JSON object representing a schedule time, including days of week and seconds or sun times.

methods.name: void sheens_pattern_add_constraints_required(cJSON * pattern)
methods.description: Adds required constraints to a pattern JSON object if not already present.

methods.name: const char * bool2str(bool value)
methods.description: Converts a boolean value to its string representation ('true' or 'false').
